$comment: Canonical daemon contract implemented by harbormaster federated_query.py. Distinct from the full federated plan in federated-query-plan.schema.json. Harbormaster vendors this file as apps/harbormaster/schemas/v1/query/federated-query-plan.schema.json.
title: Bosun federated graph query plan v1 (harbormaster runtime)
description: Distributed Graph DSL plan: one stdio worker command per vault site, then join node sets and edge matrices. Each query object is validated against graph-neighborhood-query.schema.json.

id.description: Optional plan identifier echoed in the join result

command.description: Child-process argv for a stdio JSON-RPC graph query worker

vault.description: Vault root injected into the site's Graph DSL query

query.description: Neighborhood query object validated against graph-neighborhood-query.schema.json
